g.text: Gap = max(P away, P draw, P home) minus min(P away, P draw, P home).
One unit on the most likely outcome; net winnings = odds - 1 if correct, otherwise -1.

g.text: Fixed bins of width 0.10; empty bins omitted. Labels show bets per bin; hollow points have fewer than 30 bets.
Dashed line = break-even. These are retrospective test results, not validated betting thresholds.
